function.description: Get network bugs results trend over time. The default sort is by scan time descending.
function.name: api_getNetworkBugsResultsTrendOverTime

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

scanTime.description: Return bugs trend with scanTime greater than this scanTime

catastrophicBugsCount.description: Number of network bugs which have a severity of CATASTROPHIC

moderateBugsCount.description: Number of network bugs which have a severity of MODERATE

severeBugsCount.description: Number of network bugs which have a severity of SEVERE
